structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E055. Tip E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 on seeds 0-2. Same-code rerun (E050): 5.206 s, 0.7552. E055 (group-1 freeze at 71%) gave 5.128 s, 0.7519, so about -0.07 s for about -0.16 to -0.33 pp. That is worse than the dial, so the stem freeze is not free even just after the 28→32 switch.

Mechanisms and support:
1. Epoch dial: about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch for 0.0-0.25 pp, roughly 1.5-2 s/pp (E020, E023, E027, E049).
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded, E006) are in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters were flat or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd, LS). Optimizer, averaging and regularization are flat within about 0.2 pp.
3. Time tracks pixels. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Trimming steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E045, E048, E052).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049, E053). It is bandwidth-heavy. The stem needs steady 32 px updates (E037, E054, E055 all lost). Group 2 tolerates a larger dose (E053 +0.26 pp on 3 seeds, -0.12 s).
5. Architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051).
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047). Systems work recovers at most about 1%.
7. Noise: a rebuild alone moves the 3-seed mean by about 0.3 pp and time by about ±0.03 s. The population mean is about 0.752, so headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp. The tip's 0.7535 is probably a mildly lucky draw. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of about 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted the time of freezes and selection. I under-predicted E053's accuracy.

Unsure:
- The size of the rebuild SD. I guess 0.1 pp on a 20-seed mean.
- Whether E052 and E053 pass a frozen gate. Their populations are about 0.751-0.752.
- Whether ReLU saves 3% or more. I expect 1-3%.
- Whether the coarse labels are available at all.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic. Rebuild spread of about 0.1 pp is likely; fresh-seed mean falls 0.1-0.2 pp below the selected 0.7539, which supports H4.5.1 and H4.4.3.
E052 and E053 sit at about 0.751-0.752 population mean. A strict 1.64σ gate with σ_tot near 0.12 pp probably fails them, so the outcome is a gate fail or a marginal pass.
E046 is E049 minus 0.25 epoch, so about -0.1 s and -0.05 to -0.15 pp. The dial's rate stays noisy relative to the rebuild SD.
Coarse labels are likely not provided by the loader, so it is probably blocked. If it runs, the effect is small.
The port already sets BN weight requires_grad=False (BatchNorm class), so this closes by reading the code with no run. If it is run, nothing changes.
The saving is tiny, about 0.3-0.5%, and the whitening bias converges early. Accuracy is likely neutral within noise.
Offline instrumented diagnostic. Update-rate curves will only loosely separate the known outcomes, since relative update rates decay with the LR schedule everywhere.

cruxes: What is the rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean (H4.5.1)? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep decision is real.
Is the fresh-seed population mean of the tip at or above 0.752? That sets how much margin can still be spent on time.
Do the coarse labels exist in the shipped loader, and does the rulebook allow them?
